subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: Mount Meru Center of the World
description: A fast breakdown of Mount Meru Center of the World for builders.

hook.text: In Hindu and Buddhist cosmology, Mount Meru stands at the center of the universe. The sun orbits around it.

buildup.text: Meru is made of gold, has four faces of crystal, ruby, lapis, and gold, and rises 84,000 leagues high.

discovery.text: Every Hindu temple is a symbolic Mount Meru. The tower at the center represents the cosmic mountain.

twist.text: No one can physically find Meru. It's not geographic—it's cosmographic. The mountain exists in myth, not on maps.

climax.text: Meru is the axis mundi as mountain. It organizes heaven, earth, and hell around a single immovable peak.

punchline.text: The universe has a center. You can't visit it.

quiz.question: What material is Mount Meru described as being made of?
